# RebusFarm

> > Professional cloud render farm service offering CPU and GPU rendering for 3D artists using V-Ray, Octane, and major 3D software applications.

RebusFarm provides 24/7 cloud rendering services with support for industry-standard 3D applications including Modo, Cinema 4D, 3ds Max, Maya, Rhino, and SketchUp. The platform features the Farminizer Plugin for seamless integration and offers both CPU and GPU rendering with NVIDIA hardware.

## Key Topics

- Cloud rendering
- Render farm service
- V-Ray rendering
- GPU rendering
- Octane Render
- Farminizer Plugin
- 3D animation rendering
- Visual effects rendering
- Modo rendering
- Rhino 3D rendering
- SketchUp rendering
- NVIDIA hardware
- ControlCenter
- CPU rendering
- vrscene format

## Getting Started

- [RebusFarm: Render Farm for Online Cloud Rendering Service](https://rebusfarm.net): Homepage for RebusFarm CPU & GPU cloud rendering service with 24/7 support

## Rendering Engines

- [VRay Render Farm | V-Ray Cloud Rendering](https://rebusfarm.net/3d-software/v-ray-render-farm): V-Ray render farm supporting vrscene format with 25 RenderPoints trial
- [Octane Render Farm Online | Octane Cloud Rendering](https://rebusfarm.net/3d-software/octane-render-farm): Octane GPU render farm for Cinema 4D, 3ds Max, Maya with NVIDIA hardware

## 3D Software Integration

- [Modo Render Farm: Modo Cloud Rendering](https://rebusfarm.net/3d-software/modo-render-farm): Modo render farm integration with V-Ray support via Farminizer Plugin
- [Rhino Render Farm | Rhinoceros 3D Cloud Rendering](https://rebusfarm.net/3d-software/rhino-render-farm): Rhino 3D cloud rendering service with V-Ray support and 24/7 assistance
- [SketchUp Render Farm | SketchUp Cloud Rendering](https://rebusfarm.net/3d-software/sketchup-render-farm): SketchUp render farm with V-Ray integration and free trial offering

## Community & Awards

- [3D Artist of the Year 2017](https://rebusfarm.net/aoty-2017): 2017 3D Artist of the Year contest winners and monthly competition results
- [3D Artist of the Year 2018](https://rebusfarm.net/aoty-2018): 2018 3D Artist of the Year featuring Mikhail Buleyko and monthly winners
